description: What this caller may still do today: its serial lookup allowances and how much of each it has used in the last 24 hours. Macfax is free; the allowances only pace it. Anonymous callers get 5 new serials a day and a free key gets 25, within 200 distinct serials a day; serials Macfax has already answered, pre-2021 serials and repeats within 24 hours do not count as new. Call this before a large batch of serials to find out whether it can be finished today. Works with or without a key.
name: get_macfax_limits
title: Check Macfax limits
